content:
Apple has expanded its official certified refurbished product store this week, adding new configurations of MacBook Air and MacBook Pro. Also includes an exclusive iPhone 16 Plus model, Apple Watch and more.

Apple's official certified refurbished product store is a great way to save up to 15% when buying Apple products.

  • Premium products at great prices
  • Undergoes a rigorous refurbishment process before sale
  • Comes with Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Eligible for Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare can be purchased additionally
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

Inventory at Apple's official certified refurbished product store changes quickly. So we publish this article to give you a clear picture of what's in stock, so you can place your order before they sell out.

MacBook Pro and MacBook Air

MacBook Pro

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 1TB storage and 24GB memory, Nano-texture display: $1,999 (originally $2,349 new)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 4TB storage and 64GB memory: $4,669 (originally $5,499 new)
  • 14-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro with 8TB storage and 48GB memory: $6,799 (originally $7,999 new)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 2TB storage and 24GB memory: $2,419 (originally $2,699 new)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 512GB storage and 1TB SSD: $1,099 (originally $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 1TB SSD and 24GB memory: $1,529 (originally $1,799 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 512GB and 16GB memory: $1,269 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 2TB SSD and 24GB memory: $2,119 (originally $2,499 new)

Apple Watch

  • Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular, 46mm Gold Titanium case: $639 (originally $749 new)
  • Apple Watch SE 3 GPS + Cellular, 44mm Midnight Aluminum case: $279 (originally $329 new)
  • Apple Watch Series 11 GPS, 46mm Silver Aluminum case: $369 (originally $429 new)
  • Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular, 46mm Jet Black Aluminum case: $449 (originally $529 new)

Apple TV 4K

Apple TV is very popular at the Apple Refurbished Store and sells out quickly. The standard version sold out within a few days last week, and this week only the higher-end version with built-in Ethernet remains:

  • Apple TV 4K 128GB (3rd generation) Wi-Fi + Ethernet: $209 (originally $249)

iPhone 16 Plus

  • iPhone 16 Plus 128GB – White (Unlocked): $699 (originally $829 new)
  • iPhone 16 Plus 256GB – Black (Unlocked): $789 (originally $929 new)
  • iPhone 16 Plus 512GB – White (Unlocked): $959 (originally $1,129 new) Apple no longer sells this model as a new device. If you want a 512GB iPhone 16 Plus, the refurbished store is the only way to get one.
  • …and more colors and configurations…

Check out 9to5Toys for all the latest Apple deals this week.
